messages:
elaine-sales: quick ask — Acme wants a hosted API key for a 7-day POC. need: scoped key (generation + embeddings), 3 RPS rate limit, IP allowlist, and an easy rotation/revoke path. can we do short-lived keys?

sam-eng: yes, we can issue a short-lived token tied to a POC metadata tag. default flow: create token with expiry, set rate_limit_per_minute and ip_allowlist in the key metadata. we have an internal admin endpoint to mint these.

maria-security: +1 on short-lived. need audit logs + KMS-wrapped secret and one-click revoke from console. also please capture who requested the key and attach the signed security questionnaire reference.

elaine-sales: customer will only agree if rotation is documented and we show immediate revocation. alex (customer) wants to see the revoke command. can we provide a curl example?

sam-eng: yep. plan I propose: 1) issue key with ttl=7d, 2) rotate midway (day 3) by creating new key and updating customer app, 3) auto-revoke expired key, 4) manual revoke endpoint for immediate stop.

sam-eng: here's the curl to revoke via our control plane (replace <KEY_ID>):

```bash
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood-inference.com/v1/admin/keys/<KEY_ID>/revoke" \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n  -d '{"reason":"POC compromise suspected","requested_by":"elaine-sales"}'
```

sam-eng: and for minting a short-lived key (example payload):

```json
{
  "scope": ["generation","embeddings"],
  "ttl_seconds": 604800,  // 7 days
  "rate_limit_rps": 3,
  "ip_allowlist": ["198.51.100.14/32","203.0.113.7/32"],
  "metadata": {"customer":"acme","poc_id":"acme-2026-02","requested_by":"elaine-sales"}
}
```

maria-security: make sure the token secret is shown only once on create and never returned again. support should store only key_id and metadata. audit event should include ip and user agent when created.

bot-keymgr: heads-up: created temporary key id key_7f3a2c for poc acme-2026-02. expires 2026-03-27T12:40:00Z. one-time secret displayed to creator only.

elaine-sales: perfect — can you add the rotation checklist in a one-pager I can send to Acme? they also asked about immediate revocation from their side if they rotate early.

alex-customer: hi — would be great if we could rotate from our app without contacting you (i.e., generate new key and switch). the revoke API above looks fine but we need a webhook or status endpoint to verify key state.

sam-eng: we can add a /v1/keys/<KEY_ID>/status endpoint that returns active/expired/revoked. webhook for state-changes is doable (needs product approval).

maria-security: product: if we enable webhooks for key lifecycle events, ensure payloads are signed and deliver over TLS with retry/backoff. also add a retention policy for logs tied to contract.

elaine-sales: action items: sam to mint key and share one-time secret to me, maria to confirm audit retention policy (customer contract), product to scope webhook work (optional). i'll draft the email to Acme with the curl revoke + status endpoint examples.

bot-keymgr: note: manual revoke executed by sam-eng at 1792500450 for key_7f3a2c (reason: rotate on customer request). audit id=evt_82b9f.

alex-customer: thanks team. once I get the one-time secret I'll run smoke tests and confirm.

elaine-sales: sending the one-pager now — includes step-by-step: create, rotate via new key, call revoke endpoint, and check status endpoint. also added guidance for IP allowlist and local caching TTLs to avoid stale tokens.

sam-eng: added a short TTL option (24h) if Acme wants more aggressive rotation during the POC. let me know which TTL they prefer.

alex-customer: we'll start with 7d and switch to 24h if we see long-lived tokens in logs. thanks! :thumbsup:
